violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -The pizza prep table handle is wrapped in duct tape. This is a non-cleanable surface and should be repaired.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -A grate, exposed to the kitchen, on the back of the slushy machine is dusty and in need of cleaning.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was reused or used more than one time. -Small styrofoam bowls are being used to scoop chopped onions and green peppers in the pizza prep table.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not clean or kept in good repair. -The public restrooms have a build up of lint/dust on the mechanical ventilation system.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Employees are using a small white bowl and tin scoop without handles at the pizza prep station. Those utensils were then stored in contact with the food.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -The floor of cabinets for the coffee bar are in need of cleaning. -Floor of cabinets under the "F'real" machine are in need of cleaning.
